notes: Every number the narration speaks (script.md), with the record field that holds it. A cut's records file (fleetlab.film-records/1) names the file that stands for each record.

records.job_one: the first investigation's record: <investigation dir>/job_run.json (acceptance, costs, message_log)
records.job_two: the second investigation's record, the same request with the first's library mounted: <investigation dir>/job_run.json
records.story_b_evaluation: story B's evaluation on the reserved panel: <engagement>/loop/evaluation/summary.json (states with successes and attempts; pairs with rescued and broken)
records.story_b_panel: story B's reserved attempts, one row per attempt and state: <engagement>/loop/evaluation/attempts.parquet
records.story_b_second_use: the probe recipe run on the later fleet: <second use>/recipe-check.json (episodes with each step's rows to the first movement and to half-way)
records.naive_batch: the first investigation's first batch: <run dir>/log/job_episodes.parquet
records.tuned_batch: the batch with the tuned program on the same development starts: <run dir>/log/job_episodes.parquet
records.fresh_batch: the tuned program, unchanged, on fresh development starts: <run dir>/log/job_episodes.parquet
records.second_batch: the second investigation's longer continuation: <run dir>/log/job_episodes.parquet
records.library: the installation's library after the release: <library>/index.json (a LibraryIndex)
records.job_three: the third investigation's record, the second's library mounted: <investigation dir>/job_run.json
records.third_batch: the third investigation's batch with the saved program on development starts: <run dir>/log/job_episodes.parquet
records.release_receipt: the release run's receipt: <release dir>/receipt.json (a ReleaseReceipt)
records.job_one_episodes: the first investigation's development batches: every <run dir>/log/job_episodes.parquet of job_run.json's run_dirs.development
records.job_two_episodes: the second investigation's development batches: every <run dir>/log/job_episodes.parquet of job_run.json's run_dirs.development
records.job_three_episodes: the third investigation's development batches: every <run dir>/log/job_episodes.parquet of job_run.json's run_dirs.development
records.second_job: job two's second investigation (the bowl onto the plate), job one's released library mounted: <investigation dir>/job_run.json
records.second_job_first: job two's first investigation (the bowl onto the plate), job one's run-5 library mounted: <investigation dir>/job_run.json
records.second_job_third: job two's third investigation, run-2's library mounted: <investigation dir>/job_run.json
records.second_job_third_receipt: job two's release run's receipt (the third investigation's saved job): <release dir>/receipt.json (a ReleaseReceipt)
records.second_job_third_batch: job two's third investigation's batch with the saved program (j0009) on development starts: <run dir>/log/job_episodes.parquet
records.second_job_third_library: the installation's library after job two's release run: <library>/index.json (a LibraryIndex)

acceptance_n.meaning: release starts in the agent's acceptance proposal

acceptance_k.meaning: deliveries the agent proposed to be judged on, on those starts (the third investigation's acceptance proposal)

job_one_sessions.meaning: agent sessions job one's investigation took

job_one_starts.meaning: development executions (a program run on a start) in the first investigation

job_one_model_minutes.meaning: minutes of the agent's model time in job one's investigation, rounded

job_two_sessions.meaning: agent sessions the second investigation took

job_two_starts.meaning: development executions (a program run on a start) in the second investigation

job_two_model_minutes.meaning: minutes of the agent's model time in the second investigation, rounded

b_original_success.meaning: reserved attempts that succeeded under the fleet's original state

b_attempts.meaning: reserved attempts on the panel, the same under every state

b_final_success.meaning: reserved attempts that succeeded after the agent's changes

b_rescued.meaning: reserved attempts that failed before the changes and succeeded after

b_broken.meaning: reserved attempts that succeeded before the changes and failed after

b_lagging_original.meaning: the lagging robot's reserved attempts that succeeded under the original state

b_lagging_final.meaning: the lagging robot's reserved attempts that succeeded after the changes

b_lagging_attempts.meaning: the lagging robot's reserved attempts under one state

b_later_delay_first.meaning: rows from a commanded step to the first movement on the later fleet's third-site robot r11

b_later_delay_half.meaning: rows from a commanded step to half-way on r11

b_later_isolated_first.meaning: rows to the first movement on the later fleet's isolated failing robot r06

b_later_reference_first.meaning: rows to the first movement on the healthy reference r05

naive_delivered.meaning: starts the naive program (j0001) delivered on

naive_starts.meaning: starts the naive program (j0001) ran on

tuned_delivered.meaning: starts the tuned program (j0004) delivered on

tuned_starts.meaning: starts the tuned program (j0004) ran on

fresh_delivered.meaning: starts the fresh program (j0006) delivered on

fresh_starts.meaning: starts the fresh program (j0006) ran on

second_delivered.meaning: starts the second program (j0008) delivered on

second_starts.meaning: starts the second program (j0008) ran on

library_checks.meaning: checks in the installation's library after the release

third_delivered.meaning: development starts the saved program (j0004) delivered on

third_starts.meaning: development starts the saved program (j0004) ran on

job_three_sessions.meaning: agent sessions the third investigation took

job_three_starts.meaning: development executions (a program run on a start) in the third investigation

job_three_model_minutes.meaning: minutes of the agent's model time in the third investigation, rounded

release_n.meaning: reserved release starts the saved job and the naive chain ran on

release_k.meaning: the approved K the release was judged against

release_delivered.meaning: release starts the saved job delivered on

release_naive_delivered.meaning: the same release starts the naive chain delivered on

release_rescued.meaning: release starts delivered by the job and not by the naive chain

release_broken.meaning: release starts delivered by the naive chain and not by the job

release_order_violations.meaning: the job's release runs that broke the order rule

job_one_distinct.meaning: distinct development starts the first investigation's executions ran on

job_two_distinct.meaning: distinct development starts the second investigation's executions ran on

job_three_distinct.meaning: distinct development starts the third investigation's executions ran on

lead_deliveries.meaning: deliveries in the shift lead's bar: the numerator of the lead's fraction the receipt was judged against

lead_starts.meaning: reserved starts in the shift lead's bar: the denominator of the lead's fraction

plate_dev_delivered.meaning: development starts job two's saved program (j0009) delivered on

plate_dev_starts.meaning: development starts job two's saved program (j0009) ran on

plate_release_n.meaning: reserved starts job two's release ran on

plate_release_delivered.meaning: reserved starts job two's saved program delivered on

plate_release_naive_delivered.meaning: reserved starts the naive chain delivered on, job two

plate_library_checks.meaning: checks in the installation's library after job two's release run
